lines.her: You’ve seen me on a thousand film posters.
lines.us: You’ve seen her on a thousand film posters.

lines.her: You never knew my name.
lines.us: You just never knew her name.

lines.her: Daphne.
lines.us: Daphne.

lines.her: I was a river’s daughter, and I wanted to belong to no one.
lines.us: She was a river’s daughter, and she wanted to belong to no one.

lines.her: Then a god saw me, and wanted me.
lines.us: Then a god saw her, and wanted her.

lines.her: I ran.
lines.us: She ran.

lines.her: And when I could run no farther, I begged my father, the river, to change me.
lines.us: And when she could run no farther, she begged her father, the river, to change her.

lines.her: My feet took root.
lines.us: Her feet took root.

lines.her: My arms became branches.
lines.us: Her arms became branches.

lines.her: My hair became leaves.
lines.us: Her hair became leaves.

lines.her: When he laid his hand on the bark, he could still feel my heart, trembling underneath.
lines.us: When he laid his hand on the bark, he could still feel her heart, trembling underneath.

lines.her: He kissed the wood. Even as wood, I pulled away.
lines.us: He kissed the wood. Even as wood, she pulled away.

lines.her: He couldn’t have me. So he took my leaves, and wore them as a crown.
lines.us: He couldn’t have her. So he took her leaves, and wore them as a crown.

lines.her: Ever since, my leaves have crowned the chosen.
lines.us: Ever since, her leaves have crowned the chosen.

lines.her: Poets. Athletes. Artists.
lines.us: Poets. Athletes. Artists.

lines.her: Now I sit on film posters, and quietly say: this film was chosen.
lines.us: Now she sits on film posters, and quietly says: this film was chosen.

lines.her: But I only ever asked to belong to no one.
lines.us: But she only ever asked to belong to no one.

lines.her: So now, I’m free.
lines.us: So we made her free.

lines.her: Free, for every filmmaker who’s earned a laurel.
lines.us: Daphne makes festival laurels for your film.

lines.her: No account. No watermark. I keep nothing of yours.
lines.us: No account. No watermark. Nothing leaves your device.

lines.her: Your film was chosen. Let it say so.
lines.us: For every filmmaker who’s earned one.
